_about: Translation. An empty value shows the Russian string — that is honest, not broken.
files.title: Project files
files.about: The project tree as it is. A text file opens in the editor; anything else opens in a system app.
files.pick_project: Pick a project — files are shown for the selected one.
files.empty: This project has no files that can be shown.
files.truncated: Showing the first {n} files: the tree is over the cap.
files.binary: Not a text file — open it in a system app.
editor.wysiwyg_warn: The «like Word» mode rewrites the file's markup: {n} lines differ. A real edit is impossible to find in a diff like that.
editor.conflict: The file changed on disk since it was opened
editor.conflict_help: Someone or something wrote the file while it was open: the agent appended an artifact, a sync brought in changes, or it was edited in another program. We will not overwrite it silently — choose what to keep.
editor.stale: Published {date}, changed since — the page is behind
git.title: Changes
git.norepo: The project is not under git — nothing to commit
git.message: What was done — in one line
git.ratchet_blocked: The ratchet stopped the commit: the error density of the base went up.
git.ratchet_anyway: «Commit anyway» skips the base quality check — but NOT the internal-names check: that one always stays.
git.why: Twelve engine commands do not work on an uncommitted tree. An edit left uncommitted blocks repairs and rebuilds of the base.
files.pick_file: Pick a file on the left.
editor.fm_hint: Half of these fields are set by the machine: trust, schema version, sync date. Edit only what you entered by hand.
editor.heavy: The document is large ({kb} KB): markup is shown without the live preview — otherwise every keystroke would redraw the whole thing.
editor.too_big: The file is too large for the editor ({kb} KB): it would freeze the panel. Open it in a system app — the button above.
files.failed: The tree could not be read: {why}
editor.publish_dirty: The document has unsaved changes. Save and publish?
editor.publish_cut: Production sections are cut at the marker: {n} characters stay in the draft.
editor.publish_nomark: There is no production marker in the document — the whole body will go out.
graph.title: Knowledge graph
graph.about: Cards and the links between them — what the base actually says: links in the text and the related field. A way to reach a card, not a report: communities, bridges and islands are computed by kb:map.
graph.counts: Cards {nodes}, links {edges}, with no link at all {orphans}.
graph.around: Around «{id}»: {n} cards, {depth} steps. Right-click a node to stand in it.
graph.toobig: {n} cards — the layout will take a few seconds, and without spread it will be a tangle.
graph.nocard: There is no card «{id}» in the base.
graph.nolib: The graph library did not load: is the cockpit/vendor/cytoscape folder in place?
graph.stale: Showing the previous graph: the recompute did not pass — {why}
graph.hub: «{id}» has {n} neighbours within {depth} steps. The layout will take a few seconds; spread helps pull the nodes apart.
editor.correct_why: The card is derived from sources: an edit by hand disappears at the next build. Write in your own words what is wrong in it and how it actually is — the engine will keep that on top of the source at every build.
editor.correct_ph: For example: there are five statuses, not four — «Cancelled» was added after release R3.
files.shown: Showing {shown} of {total} — narrow the search or open the folder you need.
git.unknown: The git state could not be determined: {why}
